definition: A label distribution skewed enough that accuracy and agreement statistics stop being informative, and across 4 sources a condition the archive's better instruments handle explicitly. Its consequences here: raw agreement of 0.90 to 0.99 alongside chance-corrected kappas of 0.357 to 0.573, because a class near ceiling makes concordance cheap; a judge ensemble whose errors concentrate entirely at the escalate boundary rather than between accept and reject, so overall accuracy hides where the system fails; and a hallucination detector reporting balanced accuracy and class-conditional rates rather than a single figure. The archive's practical rule is that where one class dominates, a chance-corrected statistic, a class-balanced recall, or an operating-point measure such as true positive rate at a fixed false positive rate is the number to report -- several sources here do exactly that and find their gains concentrated at the operating point rather than in the area under the curve.

evidence.note: Builds a Parkinson's screen from control data alone using a contrastive activation direction derived from synthetically degraded healthy speech and a nearest-neighbour anomaly score in face-encoder space, and gives a measurable precondition -- positive cosine between the synthetic and real disease directions -- that predicts in advance which modality the steering primitive will work on.
evidence.title: Label-Free Parkinson's Disease Screening from Face and Voice through Mechanistic Interpretability

evidence.note: Turns the hidden-role game Avalon into a diagnostic instrument rather than an arena, decomposing theory of mind into a 2x2 taxonomy of perspective-constrained binary statements, and shows by probing, ground-truth injection and steering that models represent the right answer internally while failing to say it.
evidence.title: Avalon-ToM-Bench: Evaluating Fine-Grained Theory of Mind via Asymmetric Game Mechanics

evidence.note: Puts an ensemble of LLM judges between a robot-autonomy planner and its execution layer as gating middleware that accepts, rejects or escalates each plan to human review, and reports that ensemble size barely moves accuracy while the errors concentrate at the escalate boundary rather than between accept and reject.
evidence.title: Agentic Harnesses: LLM-Driven Verification Layers for Robot Autonomy

evidence.note: Reads a frozen vision-language model's forward pass as a structured computational trace -- a graph over image patches, query tokens and generated tokens with attention as edges, processed by interleaved relational, spatial and sequential modules -- and shows that structuring the same internals prior detectors already read lifts hallucination detection from a 69-75 AUC plateau to 90.
evidence.title: UniProbe: A Learnable Token-Level Hallucination Detector for Large VLMs using Multi-Structural Internal Representations
